title: Knowledge settings: the Turso fields are contributed by the store that reads them, not shown on PostgreSQL deployments
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4BAjgQ43tqy1DvVJ

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37104 (PR #37668, contract record 7202143564 nit N1, seat ACCEPT 7202157381), filed by the owning zone ai-37000 under #37104 at the seat's direction, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards.
Grading: area:ai · domain:server · Task · p3 (seat-directed) · reach: knowledge settings page · evidence: read.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：设置页里的 Turso 连接字段只在真的用 Turso 存储时出现；平台库是 PostgreSQL 时不显示。
- 谁受益：PostgreSQL 部署的管理员不会看到一组不起作用的字段。
- 不做会怎样：PostgreSQL 部署多显示一组字段，说明文字写明不读取；功能不受影响。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

After PR #37668 the Turso group in `packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/knowledge.manifest.ts` is always shown, with a description saying it is read only when the platform database is not PostgreSQL. The store that reads `turso_url` / `turso_auth_token` (knowledge-turso) should contribute those fields instead, so a deployment that does not mount it does not show them.

## Acceptance

- On a deployment that mounts pgvector (no knowledge-turso), the Knowledge settings page shows no Turso fields; with knowledge-turso mounted, it shows them and they still reach plugin.ts's reader.
- Stored Turso values survive either way; tests pin both cases.
